title: Packers move Micah Parsons to reserve/PUP to open season

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Packers move Micah Parsons to reserve/PUP to open season
sources.description: We've known for some time that Packers defensive end Micah Parsons would not be ready to play at the start of the regular season and the team made it official on Sunday.
